_comment: The same fixture registry as counts.json, with one measurement naming a program the allowlist does not carry. tests/test_tree_counts.py runs the gate over this file and requires the gate to name the program and to run no stage of that command (SPEC R306.10, INV-305).

homes.text: The fixture tree holds {fixture_lines} lines of text across its files.

ground.counts: lines of text in the files of the fixture tree
ground.decision: how much text a fixture run of the gate reads
ground.on_move: every fixture run reads more text or less
ground.compared_to: the two files this fixture tree ships
ground.target: five lines, the size the cases here are written against
